scripts.dev: bun run --cwd api dev & bun run --cwd web dev
scripts.build: bun run --cwd api build && bun run --cwd web build && bun run --cwd simulator build
scripts.test: bun test api/tests web/src/lib simulator/src/index.test.ts && bun run test:rules
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only database --project demo-kinan-works --config firebase/firebase.json "bun test firebase/rules.test.ts"
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd api typecheck && bun run --cwd web check && bun run --cwd simulator typecheck
